summary: Iteration 160 (Telemetry & License Mgmt + Tauri scaffold cloud-safety) — full E2E verification. Ran the existing pytest suite test_iteration160_telemetry_license.py (11/11 PASS), ran the new check-empty-states.sh lint (PASS clean + verified it fails on injected violation), and Playwright-tested the LicenseManager admin UI on the live preview URL. All backend roundtrips (heartbeat→valid/invalid/unlicensed/expired/blocked, 8h rate-limit dedup, license CRUD admin-gated, install roster, self-status, configure) work as documented. Frontend admin/ shows the LicenseManager card, opens a 3-tab dialog (This install / HQ / Installs), all 13 documented data-testids resolve, issuing+deleting a license works end-to-end (toast 'License deleted' shown), the install roster lists 24 real installs, RemoteAccessManager is correctly NOT rendered on the cloud preview (Tauri gating), LicenseStatusBanner is correctly hidden (cloud install is unconfigured/unlicensed). No /app/desktop/* webpack imports leak into the cloud bundle (grep clean).
action_items: MINOR (cosmetic): /app/scripts/check-empty-states.sh has `set -e` at the top, so when the embedded python heredoc returns sys.exit(2) the shell aborts with code 2 (not 1 as the docstring claims). CI still treats any non-zero as failure, so this is not blocking — but if the recipe in README/PR template promises exit-1 behavior, either drop `set -e` or remap rc to 1 inside the loop.
critical_code_review_comments: telemetry.py: `_validate_license_status` correctly handles 'Z' suffix in expires_at via .replace('Z','+00:00') — good. license_configure auto-generates install_id only on first call (preserves on later configs) — correct.
Heartbeat rate-limit uses string ISO comparison ($gt) which works because ISO-8601 with timezone sorts lexicographically — safe.

LicenseManager.jsx loads /admin/licenses + /admin/telemetry/installs unconditionally on dialog open even for non-system_admin users; non-admins will see 403 in console but UI degrades gracefully (empty arrays). Consider gating with current_user.is_system_admin to avoid noisy logs.
LicenseStatusBanner correctly gates on (configured===true AND status in {blocked,expired,invalid}). Cloud preview (unconfigured) never shows it — verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 13 testids found, full CRUD UI flow)
